versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this release.

- Version bump only; no file or documentation changes detected.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from previous version.

- Initial release of rt-attention-analysis.
- Processes reaction-time and accuracy data from sustained-attention tasks (PVT, SART, gradCPT).
- Computes trailing-average RT windows, RT variability, cumulative statistics, lapse detection, and real-time fast/slow triggering thresholds.
- Provides bootstrap effect-size statistics and plots RT time series with trigger markers.
- Includes scripts for both real-time triggering and full data analysis pipeline.
- Supports CSV/TSV/JSON input and common CPT data columns.
